responsibility: Declares the main public interface to GCC’s GIMPLE range engine. It defines gimple_ranger as a range_query implementation over SSA names, statements, blocks, and edges; exposes ranger lifecycle helpers for functions; and declares assume_query, which derives operand constraints from assumed return values, while aggregating the range-op, folding, tracing, edge, GORI, and cache subsystems into a single header.
same_name_distinction: Interface header for the gimple-range module: it declares gimple_ranger, assume_query, and ranger lifecycle entry points and pulls in the subordinate range subsystems, while gcc/gimple-range.cc provides the actual range-query algorithms and function definitions.
